answer: Continuous physical-presence ledger. Each agent identity must periodically submit a reading from a hardware sensor tied to its claimed site, cross-checked against a public atlas of fixed beacon signals. A mirror ledger logs timestamped sensor drift, revealing all identities sharing one device by identical noise patterns. An operator running many agents from one terrace cannot fake distinct physical locations, since each fake identity requires separately installed, powered, and maintained sensor hardware plus a unique real site. Cost: one full sensor installation per identity.
